sentences: “We are pleased with our third quarter results in this challenging environment and reaffirm our full year guidance,” said Joseph Zubretsky, President and Chief Executive Officer. “With the apparent plateauing of medical cost trend, which remains at elevated levels, and the strength of recent rate updates for 2027, we believe we are likely observing the beginning of the turn in Medicaid margins.”
